disorder-name.detail: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD); DSM or ICD diagnosis; adult clinical cohort from IMpACT-NL dataset.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Single dataset: International Multi-centre persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT-NL). Normalized keyword 'IMpACT' used per keyword list.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "International Multi-centre persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT-NL)6 | Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) | None | None | Siemens Magnetom Avanto | 1 | 1.5T | 116 (43.97) | 33 (11) [19-63] | 30 (43.33) | 28 (13) [20-61] | 153 (41.18) | 34 (10) [18-61]"

age.detail: Single dataset, single site. Supplementary Table 1 reports age as 'median (SD) [range]'; the 'mean' field here contains the reported median (34). SD=10, range=[18-61]. No weighted calculation required (single site).

sex.detail: % male directly stated (41.18%). Male N = round(153 × 0.4118) = 63; Female N = 153 − 63 = 90. Female % = 100 − 41.18 = 58.82.

disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD); DSM or ICD diagnosis; all-male clinical cohort pooled from ABIDE-I (8 sites), ABIDE-II (2 sites), MITASD, and WASHASD datasets.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Four datasets: ABIDE-I (8 sites: CALTECH, CMU, Leuven_1, MaxMun, NYU, PITT, SBL, USM; normalized keyword 'ABIDE-I'), ABIDE-II (2 sites: BNI, IU; normalized keyword 'ABIDE-II'), OpenNeuro Massachusetts Institute of Technology Autism Study (MITASD; not in normalized keyword list), OpenNeuro University of Washington ASD Study (WASHASD; not in normalized keyword list). 'MITASD' and 'WASHASD' are used as dataset abbreviations—they do not appear in the standard keyword list.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I (ABIDE I)1 ... Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)" / "ABIDE II2 | ASD" / "OpenNeuro - Massachusetts Institute of Technology Autism Study (MITASD)9,10 | ASD" / "OpenNeuro – University of Washington ASD Study (WASHASD)16,17 | ASD"
dataset-of-origin.location: 41593_2023_1404_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx.md: Supplementary Table 1, Rows ABIDE-I (×8), ABIDE-II (×2), MITASD, WASHASD

age.detail: Multiple datasets (12 site-level groups). Supplementary Table 1 reports per-site age as 'median (SD) [range]'. Weighted mean computed treating per-site medians as means: Σ(n_i × median_i) / N = 5441/202 = 26.94. Pooled total SD computed as sqrt[Σ((n_i−1)×sd_i² + n_i×(median_i − grand_mean)²) / (N−1)] = sqrt(23481/201) = 10.81. Range: min=18 (multiple sites), max=62 (ABIDE-II BNI).
age.location: 41593_2023_1404_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx.md: Supplementary Table 1, Rows ABIDE-I (×8 sites), ABIDE-II (×2 sites), MITASD, WASHASD

sex.detail: All ASD patients are male (100%). Confirmed across all 12 site-level rows in Supplementary Table 1 (all show 100% male).

disorder-name.detail: Bipolar disorder (BD); paper abbreviates as 'BP'. Patients from FEMS (first episode mania) and TOP15 (a multi-diagnostic dataset). DSM or ICD diagnosis.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Two datasets: First Episode Mania Study (FEMS; not in normalized keyword list, used as 'FEMS') and TOP15 (Thematically Organized Psychosis study; normalized keyword 'TOP'). TOP15 label reflects a cohort study within the TOP registry.

age.detail: Two datasets. Supplementary Table 1 reports per-dataset age as 'median (SD) [range]'. Weighted mean treating medians as means: (38×21 + 190×32)/228 = 6878/228 = 30.17. Pooled total SD: sqrt[Σ((n_i−1)×sd_i² + n_i×(median_i − grand_mean)²) / (N−1)] = sqrt(26849/227) = 10.88. Range: min=18 (both FEMS and TOP15), max=64 (TOP15).

sex.detail: % male directly stated (47.37%). Male N = round(228 × 0.4737) = 108. Female N = 228 − 108 = 120. Verified: FEMS 38×0.7632=29 males; TOP15-BP 190×0.4158=79 males; total=108.

disorder-name.detail: Major depressive disorder (MDD); DSM or ICD diagnosis. Patients from three datasets: KANMDD, RUSMDD, and YoDA.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three datasets: OpenNeuro Kansas Musical Depression Study (KANMDD; not in normalized keyword list), OpenNeuro Russia fMRI Depression Study (RUSMDD; not in normalized keyword list), and YoDA (Young on the Move for Depression & Anxiety / Davey 2021; not in normalized keyword list). None of the three have normalized keywords in the standard list; original abbreviations are used.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "OpenNeuro - Kansas Musical Depression Study (KANMDD)7,8 | Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)" / "OpenNeuro - Russia fMRI Depression Study (RUSMDD)12,13 | MDD" / "YoDA 119 datasets are available from the principal investigators"

age.detail: Age data for the MDD group cannot be computed because YoDA (n=113, 70.2% of MDD patients) is absent from Supplementary Table 1. Available partial data—KANMDD (n=11): median=26, SD=11, range=[18-52]; RUSMDD (n=37): median=30, SD=9, range=[19-55]—cover only 29.8% (48/161) of MDD patients, making overall weighted mean/SD unreliable. Overall MDD age reported as NR.

disorder-name.detail: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD); DSM or ICD diagnosis. Patients from OCDPG and SPAINOCD datasets.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Two datasets: Obsessive-Compulsive and Problematic Gambling study (OCDPG; not in normalized keyword list) and SPAINOCD (not in normalized keyword list). Original abbreviations are used as neither appears in the standard keyword list.
